description: This file defines a helper class 'Log' that provides an interface for logging messages at various levels (VERBOSE, DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR, ASSERT) and manages logging nodes. It also contains static constants for log levels, methods for logging with different parameters, and maintains a LogNode chain for custom logging implementations.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for logging messages at various levels and managing logging nodes.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode chain to which log messages are forwarded.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Delegates log messages to the current LogNode chain with specified priority, tag, message, and optional throwable.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a message at VERBOSE level, with optional Throwable.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a message at DEBUG level, with optional Throwable.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs a message at INFO level, with optional Throwable.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a message at WARN level, with optional Throwable.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs a message at ERROR level, with optional Throwable.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs a message at ASSERT level, with optional Throwable.
